annotations.title: Make a saved week This Week

description: Makes a Saved Week the user's This Week (the week the Chop it app shows for cooking) as an independent working copy with the same servings. Replaces the current This Week; the Saved Week stays reusable. Returns the working copy servings, or null when unset. To change portions, open_saved_week, revise_weekly_menu with servings, save_week, then activate that exact new savedWeekId. Suits a request to make a saved week the current one. Requires a linked Chop it account.
name: set_this_week
